lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl \u003cb\u003efacto:
"

The E-factor (Sheldon) is kg of waste per kg of product. It depends on atom economy, yield and solvents. It ranges from < 0.1 in petrochemistry to 25–100 in the pharmaceutical industry. The 12 principles of green chemistry (Anastas and Warner) guide design: prevention, atom economy, safer solvents, catalysis, energy efficiency, renewable feedstocks, degradability…

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEn la estratosfera (1:
"

In the stratosphere (15–35 km) the Chapman cycle produces and destroys O₃: O₂ + hν(UV) → 2O; O + O₂ → O₃; O₃ + hν → O₂ + O. Ozone absorbs harmful UV radiation. Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) release Cl· under UV light: Cl· + O₃ → ClO· + O₂; ClO· + O → Cl· + O₂. Cl· is regenerated: a single atom destroys ~10⁵ O₃ molecules. The Montreal Protocol banned CFCs.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLa \u003cb\u003equími:
"

Green chemistry seeks to design processes that reduce or eliminate hazardous substances. A key indicator is atom economy: AE = (molar mass of the desired product)/(sum of the molar masses of the reactants) × 100. Additions and cycloadditions (Diels–Alder, hydrogenation) reach 100 %; substitutions and Wittig reactions, much less. Choose a route in the panel.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLa lluvia normal tien:
"

Normal rain has pH ≈ 5.6 because of dissolved CO₂. SO₂ (from burning coal and oil) is oxidized to SO₃ and forms H₂SO₄; engine NOₓ form HNO₃. Acid rain (pH < 5.6) damages forests, acidifies lakes, corrodes marble (CaCO₃ + H₂SO₄ → CaSO₄) and mobilizes toxic Al³⁺. It is mitigated with flue-gas desulfurization and catalytic converters.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLa Tierra recibe luz:
"

The Earth receives visible light and emits infrared. Greenhouse gases (CO₂, CH₄, N₂O, H₂O) absorb that IR (through molecular vibrations that change the dipole moment) and re-emit it toward the surface: without them the mean T would be ≈ −18 °C instead of +15 °C. More CO₂ increases the radiative forcing ΔF = 5.35·ln(C/C₀) W/m² (C₀ = 280 ppm).

"
